explanations: login() promotes the existing anonymous session to an authenticated one in place and returns the same id. An attacker who planted or learned that id before login (session fixation) holds a valid authenticated session as soon as the victim signs in. The fix destroys the old session and creates a new one with a fresh random id, carrying over the non-sensitive data (the intake draft). The old id then resolves to nothing, and the response sets the new cookie.
